d: In this episode of Rajdoot, Hosted by Nikhil, Written by Sajid, we look at how a student-led protest movement defeated Serbia’s powerful leader Aleksandar Vučić in a historic parliamentary election, ending his 14-year dominance of Serbian politics. You will learn how the 2024 railway station disaster that killed 16 people sparked nationwide protests, why students accused the government of corruption and authoritarianism, and how a movement born on the streets turned public anger into an electoral victory.
